LKN & Charlotte Economic Pulse: May 2026
Charlotte remains one of the fastest-growing metros in the Southeast — but growth without readiness creates risk. Here’s what LKN leaders need to watch heading into summer.

LKN Growth · Mecklenburg
Four Major Employers Commit 1,997 New Jobs to Our Region
Maersk (520 jobs, North American HQ), Scout Motors (1,200 jobs, $207M), SoFi Technologies (225 jobs), and AssetMark Financial (252 jobs, $10M) all committed to Mecklenburg County. Is your talent pipeline ready?
Workforce Watch · Spring 2026
84% of Firms Hold Hiring — While Demand Keeps Growing
84% of Charlotte-area firms expect zero headcount change while Bank of America alone needs 12–13,000 new hires and $1.4B is in the pipeline. Organizations that invest in culture, retention, and AI-readiness this summer will win.
NC Suburbs Rising
NC County Economic Vitality Index: LKN Is Well Positioned
NC Commerce launched a new index tracking wages, employment, income, and education. Early takeaway: suburbs are rising. Huntersville, Cornelius, and Davidson are exactly where investment and talent are heading. Organizations with roots and culture will capture it.
